title: PMPO outer-loop definition
description: Written by /loop-define to .kbd-orchestrator/loops/<name>/loop.json. Defines a standing loop: a goal + feedback sources + termination criteria. /loop-tick runs one cycle (one evolver cycle, which composes zeespec, kbd-analyze, and the KBD execute loop); the human is only consulted at escalation points. The Boris Cherny shape: write the loop once, the framework runs it.

measurable_criteria.description: Concrete, checkable conditions that mean the goal is met (e.g. 'all tests pass', 'open bug count == 0').

feedback_sources.description: What the tick reads between cycles to measure progress.

repo_path.description: Local filesystem path to a git repo (commit-history).

since.description: ISO8601 date — collect signals after this date (gh-issues, commit-history).

sentiment_field.description: JSON field path containing text to classify (sentiment-feed).

since_tag.description: Last known release tag; fetch everything after (changelog).

interpret.description: How to read the result: exit-code | count-delta | jsonpath+direction | described condition.

staleness_ttl_minutes.description: Do not re-fetch if last collected within this many minutes. 0 = always refresh. Defaults vary by type.

max_no_progress_ticks.description: Escalate/stop after this many ticks with no measurable improvement (default 2).

escalation_points.description: Conditions that pause the loop and ask the human via pmpo-elicit (e.g. 'zeespec NO-GO', 'capability gap FAILED', 'feedback regression', 'termination decision').

evolution_name.description: The backing iterative-evolver evolution key that /loop-tick runs one cycle of.

phases.description: Optional. When present, overrides the single-goal model. Each entry is one phase of a kbd-goal multi-phase pipeline. /loop-tick advances through phases in order, gating at human checkpoints.

name.description: Unique phase slug (e.g. ideation, spec, creation).

type.description: Phase type determines which KBD template is loaded.

stopping_condition.description: Machine-checkable condition that ends this phase. Checked by kbd-goal-evaluator after each turn.

human_gate.description: If true (default), the loop pauses at the end of this phase for human review before advancing.

token_budget.description: Token ceiling for this phase specifically. Overrides global termination.budget when set.

goal_slug.description: Optional. When this loop was created by /kbd-goal, this is the slug that links back to .kbd-orchestrator/goals/<slug>/goal.json. Allows /loop-tick to read and update goal state.

perspective.description: Which pmpo-evolver perspective to apply on each tick. 'auto' lets the evolver router decide based on data freshness and feedback signals.
